name: The Wynn Phuket
shortDescription: A small gated collection of single-storey pool villas in the Pasak area of Cherng Talay.
description: The Wynn Phuket is a small gated collection of single-storey tropical-modern pool villas in the Pasak area of Cherng Talay, with villas on plots of roughly 478 to 732 sqm. The advertised 3-bedroom, 4-bathroom villas have around 435 sqm of built-up area, vaulted timber ceilings and open-plan living leading to a private pool and garden. Boat Avenue, Porto De Phuket and the Bang Tao and Layan beaches are in the surrounding area.
paymentPlan: Reservation agreement with THB 500,000 booking fee
Ownership transfer / lease registration on completion
researchNotes: Developer's own site not found. Not Wynn Resorts. Unit land sizes per type unknown. Nearby distances are straight-line per Keller Henson. Images are renders. | Keller Henson FAQ lists the 3BR pool villa at THB 29.89M (headline THB 29.9M) and the large-plot version at THB 39.85M (headline 39.9M).
